format.startLabels: Start tags; simultaneous display may vary

format.lysResult: Word times; line boundaries inferred from words
format.preservedDetail: Preserves this content and structure relative to the current Studio TTML export.
format.lrcDetail: Exports lead-line start tags and representable empty ending tags. Word times and individual endings of overlapping lines are not preserved.
format.elrcDetail: Exports line-start and word tags. Reversed or overlapping words within a line cannot be exported. End boundaries of overlapping lead lines are not fully preserved.
format.eslrcDetail: Exports the first word’s start and every word’s end. Later word starts, gaps, and overlaps may be lost. Line boundaries follow the word envelope.
format.lysDetail: Preserves word boundaries; independent line boundaries are replaced by the word envelope.
format.assDetail: Preserves valid main-text line boundaries. Absolute boundaries of main text and timed translations and romanization are quantized to centiseconds before gaps and durations are calculated. Short units may have zero duration; text remains but highlighting loses precision. Overlap, reversed units, or main text outside its line blocks export.
format.assAttachments: Each content item becomes an event distinguished by style and name. Plain content uses its parent line’s timing; timed content uses its own envelope. Native track identity, relationships, and replacement semantics are not preserved. These are not selectable subtitle streams in a container.
format.backgroundDetail: Preserves background text without its structural relationship to the lead line.
format.assOverlap: Lead lines become independent events with vertical positions assigned by time. Review layout for complex voices, long lines, and font differences in the receiving app.
format.lrcOverlap: Preserves line-start tags, but not all individual endings of overlapping lines. Simultaneous display depends on the player.
